text:
kelly-lakefront: Hi team — Lakefront needs to onboard a multilingual (en/es/fr) PHI-aware summarizer. Private deployment + HSM required. Timeline: Q2, renewal in ~6 weeks so timing is sensitive.

maria-cs: Thanks @kelly-lakefront. Can you confirm target throughput and summary length? Also any SLA targets?

kelly-lakefront: Target ~30 req/s steady, peaks ~100 req/s. Summaries ~512 tokens. Latency ok under 1s avg. Security: HSM + 1yr audit log retention mandatory.

devon-cs: Noted. We'll need eng/infra to validate model compatibility and capacity. @ryan-ml can you do a quick feasibility/est estimate for a Dedicated deployment?

ryan-ml: Quick read: looks like a 13B fine-tuned model on medical notes. Recommend quantized 8-bit on Dedicated to balance cost/latency. Need to run safety/eval for PHI leakage + hallucination. ETA for initial triage: 3 business days.

devon-cs: Good. Also capture enablement/workshop: runbook + prompt tuning + dev walkthrough. @tasha-ps can you own runbook draft?

tasha-ps: :thumbsup: I’ll draft a runbook + FAQ. What are the top 5 failure scenarios you want covered?

maria-cs: From CS side: renewals team marked this as high risk if onboarding slips beyond 4 weeks. I’ll log it in CRM and loop AM.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preprod cluster reservation requested: 2xA100, 250GB NVMe. request-id=job-1750004444-1

ryan-ml: Eval plan (high level): 1) Safety suite for PHI leakage (seeded prompts + extraction tests) 2) Quality metrics (ROUGE + human spot checks) 3) Latency / cost bench under burst. Need sample dataset (redacted) + model weights/tokenizer.

kelly-lakefront: Uploading redacted dataset now: s3://lakefront-onboard/sample-redacted. We can provide HSM certs once NDA is done.

devon-cs: Next steps checklist: 1) Eng triage (ryan) 2) Infra reservation (deploy-bot done) 3) Safety eval (ryan) 4) Runbook (tasha) 5) Enablement call + canary (maria). Suggest daily 20m sync until canary active.

maria-cs: Scheduling daily 9am PT standups — calendar invites sent. I’ll also create a renewal-mitigation ticket and assign the AM.

kelly-lakefront: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Anything we need to unblock on our end?

ryan-ml: Please confirm model weights format (HF preferred) and tokenizer details. Also we’ll need ~200 labeled examples for hallucination test cases.

kelly-lakefront: Will push HF format weights + tokenizer to the same S3 this afternoon and provide labeled examples by EOD.

maria-cs: Great. Updating CRM: onboarding started, renewal flagged at-risk -> mitigation plan in place. AM looped.

tasha-ps: I’ll attach the first runbook draft to this thread in ~1h. Will include checklist, playbook for canary, and escalation matrix. :working_on_it:

kelly-lakefront: Perfect — looking forward to the enablement call.

maria-cs: We’ll post daily stand notes in this thread. If any blockers crop up, ping here and I’ll escalate to ops.
